name: bobi-english-adventure
description: 波波熱血英語大冒險 (Bobi English Adventure) - 全階段・全能分級英語學習樂園 (1,080 關 + Duolingo 互動小遊戲)

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const v=pkg.version; global.window={}; require('./curriculum.js'); const d=window.CURRICULUM_DATA; const totalLessons=d.reduce((s,t)=>s+t.lessons.length,0); const html=fs.readFileSync('./index.html','utf8'); const readme=fs.readFileSync('./README.md','utf8'); const changelog=fs.readFileSync('./CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); if(window.BOBI_VERSION!==v||window.CURRICULUM_VERSION!==v) throw new Error('Version mismatch in curriculum.js'); if(!html.includes('content=\"'+v+'\"')||!html.includes('v'+v)) throw new Error('Version mismatch in index.html'); if(!readme.includes('v'+v)) throw new Error('Version mismatch in README.md'); if(!changelog.includes('['+v+']')) throw new Error('Version mismatch in CHANGELOG.md'); if(d.length!==12||totalLessons!==1080) throw new Error('Curriculum count mismatch: expected 12 tiers & 1080 lessons, got '+d.length+' tiers & '+totalLessons+' lessons'); const sReg=/<script(?![^>]*src=)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi; let m; while((m=sReg.exec(html))!==null){ new Function(m[1]); } d.forEach(t=>t.lessons.forEach(l=>l.questions.forEach(q=>{ if(q.options){ const zhSet=new Set(q.options.map(o=>o.zh||o.text)); if(q.options.length!==4||zhSet.size!==4||q.options.filter(o=>o.correct).length!==1) throw new Error('Invalid options in '+l.id); } }))); console.log('✅ [5-Way Version Alignment Verified] v'+v+' across package.json, curriculum.js, index.html, README.md, CHANGELOG.md'); console.log('✅ [Frontend Syntax & Logic Verified] Inline scripts compiled cleanly!'); console.log('✅ [Curriculum & Logic Verified] Loaded '+d.length+' tiers & '+totalLessons+' levels with validated options!');"
